checks.question: numerical safety
checks.criterion: no run halted

checks.question: energy accounting closes (kinetic, wall heat, fringe work)
checks.criterion: max |relative residual| < 1e-9

checks.question: momentum accounting closes
checks.criterion: max relative residual < 1e-9

checks.question: no empty space / particle loss
checks.criterion: no POTENTIAL MODEL / NUMERICAL FAILURE flag; particle count constant

checks.question: Q1/Q2: does the stationary wall create a near-wall region of lower mean streamwise velocity?
checks.criterion: at every station 150, 210, 310, 410: velocity deficit U_e − u_wall and deficit thickness δ₁ each with seed t ≥ 5 (FAIL if at every station the deficit's 95 % CI lies below 0.05)

checks.question: Q1/Q2: does the stationary wall create a near-wall region of lower mean streamwise velocity?
checks.criterion: at every station 150, 210, 310, 410: velocity deficit U_e − u_wall and deficit thickness δ₁ each with seed t ≥ 5 (FAIL if at every station the deficit's 95 % CI lies below 0.05)

checks.question: falsification: is the near-wall structure caused by wall momentum transfer (absent for a specular wall)?
checks.criterion: Aw = 0: the 95 % CI of the deficit lies within ±0.2 × the Aw = 1 deficit at every station (FAIL if entirely outside), and the floor's tangential impulse is exactly 0

checks.question: is the inflow over the specular lead-in free of a near-wall deficit?
checks.criterion: |deficit| at x = 70 ≤ 0.05 + 3 SE in every case

checks.question: is the wall momentum transfer (tangential impulse) measurable?
checks.criterion: plate-mean τ_w (impulse per time per length) seed t ≥ 5 for Aw = 1 and 0.5

checks.question: Q2: is the structure reproducible across independent seeds?
checks.criterion: odd/even seed halves: δ₁ agree (|z| < 3) and the deficit is significant (t ≥ 3) in each half, at every station

checks.question: Q3: is the near-wall structure stationary over the measurement (sampling-duration convergence)?
checks.criterion: near-wall velocity, second vs first half of the measurement: the 95 % CI of the paired relative change lies within ±0.15 at every station (FAIL if entirely outside)

checks.question: Q3: does the thickness depend on the spatial bin width?
checks.criterion: half-deficit height y½ and near-wall velocity at (Δx, Δy) = (20, 2) vs (40, 4), and y½ at Δy = 1: 95 % CI of each relative difference within ±0.15 (FAIL if entirely outside)

checks.question: Q3: is the near-wall structure converged in timestep?
checks.criterion: δ₁ and τ_w at x = 150: 95 % CI of each relative difference within ±0.15 (FAIL if entirely outside)

checks.question: Q3: is the near-wall structure converged in length?
checks.criterion: δ₁ and τ_w at x = 150: 95 % CI of each relative difference within ±0.15 (FAIL if entirely outside)

checks.question: Q3/falsification: does the structure survive higher particle resolution?
checks.criterion: deficit still significant (t ≥ 5); FAIL if its 95 % CI lies below 0.2 × the reference deficit; thickness ratio reported

checks.question: Q3: is the near-wall structure converged in height?
checks.criterion: δ₁ and τ_w at x = 150: 95 % CI of each relative difference within ±0.15 (FAIL if entirely outside)

checks.question: Q3: is the near-wall structure converged in height?
checks.criterion: δ₁ and τ_w at x = 150: 95 % CI of each relative difference within ±0.15 (FAIL if entirely outside)

checks.question: Q3: is the near-wall structure converged in height?
checks.criterion: δ₁ and τ_w at x = 210: 95 % CI of each relative difference within ±0.15 (FAIL if entirely outside)

checks.question: Q4: does the deceleration create a measured wall-pressure rise, and does the near-wall flow respond?
checks.criterion: wall-pressure rise (impulse-measured) seed t ≥ 5, and near-wall velocity over x ∈ (280, 480) lower than the attached control (Welch z ≤ −5)

checks.question: Q4: does the deceleration create a measured wall-pressure rise, and does the near-wall flow respond?
checks.criterion: wall-pressure rise (impulse-measured) seed t ≥ 5, and near-wall velocity over x ∈ (280, 480) lower than the attached control (Welch z ≤ −5)

checks.question: Q4: does the deceleration create a measured wall-pressure rise, and does the near-wall flow respond?
checks.criterion: wall-pressure rise (impulse-measured) seed t ≥ 5, and near-wall velocity over x ∈ (280, 480) lower than the attached control (Welch z ≤ −5)

checks.question: Q3/Q4: is the near-wall response to the deceleration converged in the timestep variant?
checks.criterion: response-window u_wall and τ_w: 95 % CI of the difference from the reference within ±0.02 and ±0.002 (FAIL if entirely outside)

checks.question: Q3/Q4: is the near-wall response to the deceleration converged in the length variant?
checks.criterion: response-window u_wall and τ_w: 95 % CI of the difference from the reference within ±0.02 and ±0.002 (FAIL if entirely outside)

checks.question: Q3/Q4: is the near-wall response to the deceleration converged in the resolution variant?
checks.criterion: the variant still responds (u_wall below the attached control, Welch z ≤ −5); differences reported

checks.question: Q3/Q4: is the near-wall response to the deceleration converged in the height variant?
checks.criterion: the variant still responds (u_wall below the attached control, Welch z ≤ −5); differences reported

checks.question: detector sensitivity: does the same detector find the recirculation behind a floor rib (geometric separation)?
checks.criterion: a separated region in (220, 400) with region-mean τ_w and ψ_wall t ≤ −t_0.025 and a bounded return-flow layer in most columns

checks.question: Q5 / indicator A: does local reverse streamwise motion appear (strong deceleration)?
checks.criterion: ≥ 1 run of ≥ 2 contiguous columns in (120, 480) with seed-mean near-wall u < 0, one-sided p ≤ 0.005 each; FAIL if every column is significantly forward (u_wall and τ_w both t ≥ t_0.005)
checks.measured: none; most negative column x 370: u_wall -0.0181 ± 0.0051 (t -3.56, n 8)

checks.question: thermal-noise null: does the attached control produce apparent separation?
checks.criterion: no separated region in the attached control (same rule as II2)
checks.measured: 0 region(s); most negative column t 18.0; max fraction of negative block means 0.0125

checks.question: indicator E: does a larger momentum deficit develop downstream of the deceleration?
checks.criterion: momentum-flux deficit thickness δ₂ at x = 470: strong case > attached control, Welch z ≥ 3

checks.question: Q8: does the separation threshold move when the wall accommodation changes?
checks.criterion: reported: smallest expansion with a separated region for Aw = 1 and Aw = 0.5, and the region-mean near-wall velocity difference at equal expansion
checks.measured: threshold Aw=1: none in range; Aw=0.5: none in range; r 2: 0.0303 vs 0.00673 (z 5.47); r 2.5: 0.00873 vs -0.00217 (z 2.69)
